Wilson's Warbler: Wilson's Warblers migrate from Alaska to Central America each year!
Winter Wren: Winter Wrens have one of the loudest songs for their size!
Wood Duck: Wood Ducks nest in tree cavities, sometimes 60 feet high!
Wood Stork: Wood Storks are the only stork that breeds in North America!
Wood Thrush: Wood Thrushes can sing two notes simultaneously with their syrinx!
Yellow Warbler: Yellow Warblers can recognize and reject cowbird eggs from their nests!
Yellow-bellied Sapsucker: Sapsuckers drill neat rows of holes in trees to drink sap!
Yellow-billed Cuckoo: Yellow-billed Cuckoos are also called 'rain crows' for calling before storms!
Yellow-crowned Night-Heron: Yellow-crowned Night-Herons specialize in eating crabs!
Yellow-headed Blackbird: Yellow-headed Blackbirds are the only blackbird with a yellow head!
Yellow-rumped Warbler: These warblers are one of the few that can digest wax from bayberries!
Yellow-throated Vireo: Yellow-throated Vireos are one of the most colorful vireos!
